assets.alt: Rain falls over Little India shops as two pedestrians share an umbrella on the wet street.
assets.caption: Little India, Singapore, photographed in February 2013. A real wet-weather street scene, not a test of the clothing or footwear discussed in this guide.
assets.review: Writer inspected actual photograph; independent review pending

media_plan.approach: One strong real Singapore rainy-street photograph establishes the setting. The original outfit prose and accessible product comparison table supply specific service value; no generic school or notebook filler.

placements.rationale: Actual garment differences and outfit instructions are expressed precisely in text/table; a generic garment photograph would imply an unverified model or wear test.
